evidence.excerpt: Ivona is actively looking for collaborators who generate high-throughput biological data (transcriptomics, proteomics, metabolomics) and need principled probabilistic approaches to network inference; she is less interested in purely applied software development roles. Her group has access to a 128-core HPC cluster at BioSense and can contribute compute time to collaborative projects.
